description.value:
You trigger an explosion at a point within range. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered there must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 8d6 fire damage, taking half as much on a success. The blast spreads around corners and ignites unattended flammable objects in the area.

Cast with a tech slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 3
